messages.text: Sounds like you had a productive evening wrapping things up. I'm glad to hear you managed to get out of the office.

As for the student loans, it’s been steady progress — not exactly fun, but at least it feels like I’m moving forward. How about you — hope your wrap-up went smoothly and you got to head out soon like you mentioned!
Work's been keeping me on my toes lately, but I'm hanging in there. Thanks for asking — how about you, how's that student loan repayment plan treating you?
Oh, it's been a bit of a process — I've been making steady payments, but it's definitely a long road. Thanks for asking, though! How about you, how's work been treating you lately?
And how's your student load debt?
Thanks, Thomas — appreciate that. Yeah, it's been a busy one, but I'm glad to hear you're powering through your work-from-home day!
Hope your wrap-up goes smoothly and you get to head out soon. Sounds like you've got a busy day too!
I appreciate the kind words—yes, I'm still here wrapping up, and I'll be heading out soon. Thanks for checking in.
Thanks for the well-wishes — I appreciate that. Hope your wrap-up goes smoothly too, and you get to head out soon.
Yeah, still at the office here — wrapping up a few things before I head out. Hope you manage to knock everything off your plate today!

Hi Therion, thanks for getting back to me. Hope you're having a good day so far.
